evals.name: blog-with-rss-darkmode
evals.prompt: set up a quarto blog for me called 'data-bites'. i want post categories and an RSS feed working, a dark mode toggle, and an about page using the trestles layout. render it and make sure the feed actually gets generated
evals.expected_output: A rendered blog project: _quarto.yml (website project, site-url + description set), index.qmd listing with categories+feed, light/dark theme pair, about.qmd with template: trestles, _site/index.xml present

evals.name: book-pdf-epub-multiformat
evals.prompt: im writing a short book (3 chapters is fine as placeholders) and i want ONE quarto project that gives me a website, a PDF without installing any LaTeX, and an epub with a cover image that i could submit to a store later. set it up and render all three outputs
evals.expected_output: A book project rendering _book/ with index.html, a Typst-generated PDF, and an .epub containing the cover image and a stable identifier; downloads: [pdf, epub] configured

evals.name: typst-cv-custom-template
evals.prompt: make me a one-page CV pdf with quarto and typst — no latex. name: Ricky Macharm, title: Financial Engineer, sections for experience, education and skills with placeholder content. i want a custom look: navy blue header band with my name in white, gold accent color for section headings
evals.expected_output: A .qmd + typst-show.typ (template-partials) rendering a single-page PDF via format: typst with the requested navy/gold styling

evals.name: gh-pages-ci-freeze
evals.prompt: my quarto website has python code chunks in it. i want it to auto-publish to github pages on every push to main WITHOUT github actions needing to install python or run my notebooks. set up whatever files are needed and explain the one-time steps i have to run myself
evals.expected_output: .github/workflows/publish.yml using quarto-dev/quarto-actions with target gh-pages, freeze: auto in _quarto.yml, instructions to render locally, commit _freeze/, and run quarto publish gh-pages once

evals.name: scaffold-validate-report
evals.prompt: scaffold a new branded report project called quarterly-summary, add a status box showing 'Q3 Revenue: $1.2M', validate the project, then render the PDF
evals.expected_output: scripts/scaffold.py creates quarterly-summary/ with report.qmd, typst-show.typ, typst-template.typ, _brand.yml, pyproject.toml, and images/; scripts/validate.py reports [OK] with no missing-file errors; quarto render produces quarterly-summary/report.pdf using the status-box() helper

evals.name: dashboard-valuebox-tabset
evals.prompt: build a quarto dashboard called sales-dashboard with a value box showing total revenue, and a row below it with a tabset containing a chart tab and a table tab (placeholder data is fine). render it.
evals.expected_output: A format: dashboard .qmd rendering to HTML with a valuebox card (content: valuebox) for total revenue, a row with .tabset containing two cards (chart + table), and a successful quarto render with no errors

evals.name: manuscript-with-profiles
evals.prompt: set up a quarto manuscript project called reproducible-paper with one placeholder notebook exposed to readers, and add a dev/production profile pair where dev skips freeze and production enables it
evals.expected_output: project: type: manuscript in _quarto.yml with manuscript: article: + notebooks: listing the placeholder notebook; a _quarto-production.yml (or equivalent profile file) setting execute: freeze: false in dev and freeze: true in production (or vice versa per the prompt), switchable via --profile/QUARTO_PROFILE
